reviews.review: I recommend this game to all those who like simulation shooter/war games. For the life of me, I can't figure out how to be "good" at the game. Something with the controls feel off, like there is a constant latency, I can't ever hit anything I'm shooting at, I could hardly pass the tutorials, it's hard to control my character, inventory is tasking, and I've died repeatedly on the first "mission". So with THAT being said, it's a very good combat simulator. I personally have tried repeatedly, and just can't enjoy it. So, kudos to those that play it 24/7, and best of luck to you all.

Arma 3 is truly one of a kind.
Beacuse there's nothing like it out there right now BI has an effective monopoly on the "Open World 1st/3rd person Millitary Combined-Arms Genre" OW13MCA? but anyways Bohemia has little incentive to improve in many areas
due to the situation. However many problems like : lack of weapon variety (combat shotguns, pistols, sniper rifles)
lack of a diverse set of both CAS and Non-combat aircraft and currently terrible civillan options, can be fixed in a sense
by the strong modding community. It's far from flawless but it is ulike anything you can find right now. 
(keep in mind that this game is porly omptimized so if you don't have a beast computer watch out)
Overall I think it's a game you should try. It's nearly endless content can entertain for 100s of hours. and if you not
into hardcore milsim stuff there is always the many RPG gamemodes like Altis Life.

Still very much in the heart of the modding community. Great support from the Dev's on this front. Game has it's issues, mainly with vehicles bouncing over the landscape. Really not as well optomised for current hardware which is a real shame. Best advice I can give you is make sure the graphic settings are on high. The Arma game engine has a bad habit of forcing the CPU to perform grahics tasks if you set LOW/MEDIUM detail levels - on old PC's this helped where the CPU was often more powerful than the GPU - however in current machines with highly dedicated graphics processors even a "low end" graphics card should be run on high detail. 

Multiplayer is great in this game, suggest trying the EPOCH, WASTELAND, and "INVADE&ANNEX" mods. EPOCH will require a big download as it's a total conversion with zombies and cool stuff, Wasteland is a straight mod mainly for PVP group/solo with lots of options for good fun and constant action. Whislt the invade and annex mod is great for large scale CO-OP PVE, with 30-60 players versus the NPC army.
Hours, months, years worth of content and so many great moments!
Great gome to play with mates online and you have a thrilling singlr player too.
